text:
nadiya: quick flag  post-keystore rotation a handful of SAST jobs aborted with KMS.Decrypt denied. losing evidence and creating noisy vuln churn. cc @oncall-sre

eric: i rotated the keyring at 02:50 UTC and ran a policy cleanup. i may have removed svc-scanner from the cryptoKeyDecrypter binding by mistake. looking at audit now.

samir: CI excerpt:
`Fetch artifact -> kms.Decrypt: PermissionDenied
scanner: exit 1`
we should avoid deleting encrypted bundles on error.

nadiya: mitigation plan: (1) grant short-lived decrypt to svc-scanner (30m) using iam condition, (2) re-run failed matrices, (3) persist encrypted bundles + logs to gs before decrypt step, (4) tag resulting issues with `sdlc:rotation` for filtering.

eric: applying conditional binding now. will post audit id. planned command:
`gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/prod-llm-key --member=serviceAccount:svc-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-30T03:30:00Z"),title=tmp_scanner_decrypt'`

eric: audit id (redacted): AUD-XYZ-123 at 02:55 UTC. binding live.

samir: add this tiny workflow step so we keep evidence even if decrypt fails:
`- name: Archive encrypted bundle
  run: |
    gsutil cp bundle.enc gs://vuln-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/bundle.enc || true
    gsutil cp scanner-logs.tgz gs://vuln-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/scanner-logs.tgz || true`

sec-bot: alert muted for 1h while re-runs in progress to avoid noisy paging.

oncall-sre: monitoring backlog and scan SLOs. will report counts when done.

nadiya: follow-ups: eric remove temp binding after re-runs (due 30m), samir land archive step in pipeline (EOD), oncall-sre confirm successful re-run counts (2h). root cause candidate: keystore rotation + policy cleanup removed scanner decrypt role. will capture checklist for rotations. :memo:
